The entry, filed under identifier 95121, states that the action was taken on July 31, 2024. The record lists the MiniMed 620G Insulin Pump, REF: MMT-1510, MMT-1710, MMT-1750; MiniMed 630G Insulin Pump, REF: MMT-1515, MMT-1714, MMT-1715, MMT-1754, MMT-17 under advisory committee "not stated" and describes the outcome as "not stated". The filing is retrievable from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration public database, and the entry carries product code OYC with device class Z-0002-2025.

No additional submissions are listed against this identifier in the retrieved entry.
